_note: ILLUSTRATIVE NUMBERS ONLY - not real fees, duty or quotes. Replace every value and record its source. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_tax: vat_registered flips revenue (ex VAT vs gross), import VAT (recoverable vs cost) and VAT on Amazon fees/ads. postponed_vat_accounting affects cash only.
_vat_threshold: Used only by --vat-compare. Take the current figure from gov.uk/register-for-vat and record the date in sources.
_purchase: Supplier currency per unit; fx is GBP per 1 unit of supplier currency at spot; fx_and_payment_fee_pct is bank/platform margin on top.
_import: Per order, GBP. duty_rate from the UK tariff for the exact commodity code and origin (include any additional duty). If NOT VAT-registered, enter UK service costs VAT-inclusive.
_selling: selling_price_gbp is the VAT-inclusive list price. promo_discount_pct is the average discount across ALL units (e.g. 10% voucher redeemed on half of orders = 0.05). Fees ex VAT from the current rate card. fulfilment_fee_gbp is the FBA fee, or your own pick/pack/postage for FBM.
_ceiling: target_margin = contribution after ads / net revenue. Used only by --ceiling (stage 2, before a quote exists); unit_cost_supplier_ccy may be left at 0 for that run.
_business: monthly_units is an ASSUMED sales rate until measured. one_off costs (samples, tooling, photography, testing, trade mark) and launch_ad_budget count towards cash, not unit profit.
_timing: Days. deposit_pct paid at order; balance assumed paid at shipment.

sources._format: field: label, source, date - e.g. duty_rate: OBS, gov.uk trade tariff commodity 3924900090 origin CN, 2026-11-13
